commands.command:
set -eu
KEY="$HOME/.ssh/id_ed25519"
PI="michal@192.168.0.23"
WT="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/worktrees/unified-ux-20261104-v1"
test "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = "09be8c4ef70a30791de2698c1c39779e4ab544eb"
test "$(shasum -a 256 "$WT/frontend/dist/index.html" | awk '{print $1}')" = "ccc80c6f664853030e4674dfc783ec1607a9923e823b10f35b221a7348e48a1d"
scp -i "$KEY" -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 "$WT/frontend/dist/index.html" "$PI:/home/michal/src/PhotoMaps/frontend/dist/index.html.next"
ssh -i "$KEY" -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 "$PI" 'bash -s' <<'PI_SCRIPT'
set -eu
cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps
BACKUP=".dev/deploy/unified-ux-20261104-09be8c4"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "09be8c4ef70a30791de2698c1c39779e4ab544eb"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
test "$(sha256sum frontend/dist/index.html.next | awk '{print $1}')" = "ccc80c6f664853030e4674dfc783ec1607a9923e823b10f35b221a7348e48a1d"
test "$(sha256sum frontend/dist/index.html | awk '{print $1}')" = "$(sha256sum "$BACKUP/index-before.html" | awk '{print $1}')"
test -s frontend/dist/assets/index-C6t6Kjzg.js
test -s frontend/dist/assets/public-map-DWDElC8J.js
test "$(systemctl show photomap.service --property MainPID --value)" = "$(cat "$BACKUP/backend-pid-before")"
test "$(systemctl show cloudflared.service --property MainPID --value)" = "$(cat "$BACKUP/tunnel-pid-before")"
echo INDEX_STAGED_AND_VERIFIED
PI_SCRIPT

set -eu
KEY="$HOME/.ssh/id_ed25519"
PI="michal@192.168.0.23"
activated=0
rollback() {
  if [ "$activated" -eq 1 ]; then
    ssh -i "$KEY" -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 "$PI" 'cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps && cp .dev/deploy/unified-ux-20261104-09be8c4/index-before.html frontend/dist/index.html.rollback && mv -f frontend/dist/index.html.rollback frontend/dist/index.html' || true
    echo "PUBLIC_VALIDATION_FAILED_INDEX_RESTORED" >&2
  fi
}
trap rollback ERR
ssh -i "$KEY" -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 "$PI" 'bash -s' <<'PI_SCRIPT'
set -eu
cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps
BACKUP=".dev/deploy/unified-ux-20261104-09be8c4"
activated=0
rollback() {
  if [ "$activated" -eq 1 ]; then
    cp "$BACKUP/index-before.html" frontend/dist/index.html.rollback
    mv -f frontend/dist/index.html.rollback frontend/dist/index.html
    echo "LOCAL_VALIDATION_FAILED_INDEX_RESTORED" >&2
  fi
}
trap rollback ERR
test "$(sha256sum frontend/dist/index.html.next | awk '{print $1}')" = "ccc80c6f664853030e4674dfc783ec1607a9923e823b10f35b221a7348e48a1d"
mv -f frontend/dist/index.html.next frontend/dist/index.html
activated=1
echo INDEX_ATOMICALLY_SWITCHED
test "$(sha256sum frontend/dist/index.html | awk '{print $1}')" = "ccc80c6f664853030e4674dfc783ec1607a9923e823b10f35b221a7348e48a1d"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "09be8c4ef70a30791de2698c1c39779e4ab544eb"
test "$(systemctl is-active photomap.service)" = active
test "$(systemctl is-active cloudflared.service)" = active
test "$(systemctl show photomap.service --property MainPID --value)" = "$(cat "$BACKUP/backend-pid-before")"
test "$(systemctl show cloudflared.service --property MainPID --value)" = "$(cat "$BACKUP/tunnel-pid-before")"
curl -fsS --max-time 12 http://127.0.0.1:8000/health -o /dev/null
curl -fsS --max-time 12 http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/places/map -o /dev/null
curl -fsS --max-time 12 http://127.0.0.1:8000/ -o /tmp/photomap-unified-ux-local-index.html
grep -q '/assets/index-C6t6Kjzg.js' /tmp/photomap-unified-ux-local-index.html
grep -q '/assets/public-map-DWDElC8J.js' /tmp/photomap-unified-ux-local-index.html
curl -fsS --max-time 12 http://127.0.0.1:8000/assets/index-C6t6Kjzg.js -o /dev/null
curl -fsS --max-time 12 http://127.0.0.1:8000/assets/public-map-DWDElC8J.js -o /dev/null
echo "PI_INDEX_SHA256=$(sha256sum frontend/dist/index.html | awk '{print $1}')"
echo "PI_RELEASE_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "BACKEND_PID=$(systemctl show photomap.service --property MainPID --value)"
echo "TUNNEL_PID=$(systemctl show cloudflared.service --property MainPID --value)"
trap - ERR
echo PI_STATIC_ACTIVATION_PASS
PI_SCRIPT
activated=1
curl -fsS --connect-timeout 8 --max-time 20 "https://photomap.pl/?release=09be8c4" -o /tmp/photomap-ux-public-release.html
grep -q '/assets/index-C6t6Kjzg.js' /tmp/photomap-ux-public-release.html
grep -q '/assets/public-map-DWDElC8J.js' /tmp/photomap-ux-public-release.html
curl -fsS --connect-timeout 8 --max-time 20 https://photomap.pl/health -o /dev/null
curl -fsS --connect-timeout 8 --max-time 25 https://photomap.pl/api/places/map -o /dev/null
curl -fsS --connect-timeout 8 --max-time 25 https://photomap.pl/assets/index-C6t6Kjzg.js -o /dev/null
curl -fsS --connect-timeout 8 --max-time 25 https://photomap.pl/assets/public-map-DWDElC8J.js -o /dev/null
echo "PUBLIC_INDEX_ASSETS=$(grep -oE '/assets/index-[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+\.js' /tmp/photomap-ux-public-release.html | head -n1)"
trap - ERR
echo PUBLIC_FRONTEND_RELEASE_PASS
